pages.text: Apple pie filled the cabin with its smell. Grandpa took the pie from the oven.
Nils wanted some. "As soon as it cools!" Grandpa asked him for just two more apples.
Nils opened the storeroom door and went in. Autumn apples lined the shelves.
"I'll close it later!" With apples in his arms, he ran out. The door stayed wide open.
Nils waited by the kitchen window for pie. Outside, two squirrels scurried toward the storeroom.
Rustling came from inside. He ran over.
Apples had rolled off the shelves, with gnawed marks all over. Instead of pie, Nils gathered apples.
Holding the door, Grandpa asked, "What shall we do with this door?"
Nils moved the gnawed apples aside, then shut the door firmly. Click went the latch too!
Grandpa warmed the pie again. Nils took a big bite of a slice. "Pie after closing the door tastes best!"
